name: FatalMC
description:
FatalMC is a high quality Network. Our main focus is our Lifesteal mode, as well as our FFA Mode. We plan to add additional modes in the near future of FatalMC.

Upon the servers release, you we have the modes:

Lifesteal - A competitive twist to a survival smp

FFA - Compete with players in pvp to become #1

Available versions

Our server is available to join by everyone, to engage the community as much as possible!

・Java Edition
